mapper.select: INSERT INTO public.attendance_policy_version ( department_id, version_no, name, check_in_start_time, status, created_by_account_id ) VALUES ( #{departmentId}, #{versionNo}, #{name}, #{checkInStartTime}, 'DRAFT', #{actorAccountId} ) RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.attendance_band ( policy_version_id, sequence_no, label, parent_status, upper_time ) VALUES ( #{policyVersionId}, #{band.sequenceNo}, #{band.label}, #{band.parentStatus}, #{band.upperTime} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public.attendance_band AS band WHERE band.policy_version_id = #{policyVersionId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.attendance_policy_version AS policy WHERE policy.id = band.policy_version_id AND policy.status = 'DRAFT' )
mapper.select: SELECT id, sequence_no, label, parent_status, upper_time FROM public.attendance_band WHERE policy_version_id = #{policyVersionId} ORDER BY sequence_no
